set_option autoImplicit false

theorem odd_power_period_two_residue_mod_three (B : ℕ) : ∃ r : ℕ → ℕ, r 0 = 1 ∧ r 1 = 2 ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, r (k + 2) = r k) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ B → r (2 * n) = 1 ∧ r (2 * n + 1) = 2) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, r k = 2 ^ k % 3) := by
  use fun k => 2 ^ k % 3
  constructor
  · 
    norm_num
  constructor
  · 
    norm_num
  constructor
  · 
    intro k
    have h : 2 ^ (k + 2) % 3 = 2 ^ k % 3 := by
      have h₁ : 2 ^ (k + 2) % 3 = (2 ^ k * 2 ^ 2) % 3 := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₁]
      have h₂ : (2 ^ k * 2 ^ 2) % 3 = (2 ^ k % 3 * (2 ^ 2 % 3)) % 3 := by
        simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod]
      rw [h₂]
      have h₃ : 2 ^ 2 % 3 = 1 := by norm_num
      rw [h₃]
      have h₄ : (2 ^ k % 3 * 1) % 3 = 2 ^ k % 3 := by
        simp [Nat.mul_mod]
      rw [h₄]
    simpa using h
  constructor
  · 
    intro n hn
    constructor
    · 
      have h : 2 ^ (2 * n) % 3 = 1 := by
        have h₁ : 2 ^ (2 * n) % 3 = 1 := by
          have h₂ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k) % 3 = 1 := by
            intro k
            induction k with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ k ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
              <;> norm_num <;> omega
          exact h₂ n
        exact h₁
      simpa using h
    · 
      have h : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
        have h₁ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
          have h₂ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k + 1) % 3 = 2 := by
            intro k
            induction k with
            | zero => norm_num
            | succ k ih =>
              simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, ih]
              <;> norm_num <;> omega
          exact h₂ n
        exact h₁
      simpa using h
  · 
    intro k
    rfl

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem odd_power_period_two_residue_mod_three (B : ℕ) : ∃ r : ℕ → ℕ, r 0 = 1 ∧ r 1 = 2 ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, r (k + 2) = r k) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ B → r (2 * n) = 1 ∧ r (2 * n + 1) = 2) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, r k = 2 ^ k % 3) := by
  let r : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => 2 ^ k % 3
  
  have hper : ∀ k : ℕ, r (k + 2) = r k := by
    intro k
    dsimp [r]
    rw [pow_add]
    norm_num [Nat.mul_mod]
  
  have hvals : ∀ n : ℕ, r (2 * n) = 1 ∧ r (2 * n + 1) = 2 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        norm_num [r]
    | succ n ih =>
        constructor
        · rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = (2 * n) + 2 by omega]
          rw [hper]
          exact ih.1
        · rw [show 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = (2 * n + 1) + 2 by omega]
          rw [hper]
          exact ih.2
  
  refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_, hper, ?_, ?_⟩
  · norm_num [r]
  · norm_num [r]
  · intro n hn
    exact hvals n
  · intro k
    rfl
